stage: Stage 0 / Stage C sub-gate: E(D4) < E(D1) on GSE184929 (blocking)
supports: Direction-1 modification-aware representation + the monotone-readout certificate

ddg_calibration.guide: Schlegel 2022 Ttr; D1 parent vs D4 g7 (S)-GNA
ddg_calibration.model: g7 (S)-GNA modeled as a Watson-Crick A->C mismatch (real ViennaRNA duplexfold); an upper bound on the true GNA penalty (ViennaRNA has no GNA sugar parameters)

delta_tm_calibration.reason: a learned ddG-magnitude head calibrated on Schlegel 2017 delta-Tm data needs that real delta-Tm table, which is not in the repo; the sub-gate needs only the destabilization sign, which the real ViennaRNA mismatch dG provides

off_target_readout: E(guide) = ||P_alpha(mouse TRRUST) e||_2 with e = occupancy(guide) * GSE184929 D1-seed-match count per gene (monotone in occupancy)

monotone.certificate: E is linear in occupancy and D1/D4 hit the same sites, so E(D4) = (occ_D4/occ_D1) E(D1); occ_D4 < occ_D1 implies E(D4) < E(D1) by construction

non_monotone_control.note: the count-only readout ignores occupancy, so it predicts the same off-target for D1 and D4 and CANNOT reproduce the inequality; this motivates the monotone design

decision: PASS: the monotone modification-aware readout outputs E(D4) < E(D1); proceed.
